# Tools That Work

Tools That Work is an independent AI and SaaS review publication for founders, operators, creators, and builders.

## What the site covers
- Hands-on AI and SaaS reviews
- AI app builders and prompt-to-app platforms
- AI writing, SEO, newsletter, and content tools
- AI video, image, and creative production tools
- Practical comparison pages for software buying decisions
- Review methodology and affiliate disclosure

## Important pages
- Homepage: https://toolsthatworks.com/
- Reviews: https://toolsthatworks.com/reviews
- AI tool comparisons: https://toolsthatworks.com/compare
- Testing methodology: https://toolsthatworks.com/how-we-test
- AI app builders: https://toolsthatworks.com/category-ai-app-builders
- AI writing and SEO tools: https://toolsthatworks.com/category-ai-writing-seo
- AI video and image tools: https://toolsthatworks.com/category-ai-video-image

## Editorial policy
Tools That Work publishes practical reviews and comparisons based on real workflows. Affiliate links may earn commission, but paid placements are not accepted.
